```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
```

## Results

Two CONSECUTIVE rotated tables followed by an UPRIGHT one. The run of two is
what Phase 1.14 collapses into a single landscape section; the upright table
ends the run and must keep its own layout untouched.

`apa.cor.table(attitude)` is deliberately NOT used here: it measures 5.44 in
inside a manuscript's 6.5 in block and does not rotate (D61), so it would have
made this a one-rotated-table fixture reporting the opposite conclusion. That
mistake was made once already, in this phase's own measure round.

`tbl-runa`: rotated.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-runa
#| tbl-cap: "CAPTIONRUNA"
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(mtcars))
```

`tbl-runb`: rotated, a different width so the two are distinguishable.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-runb
#| tbl-cap: "CAPTIONRUNB"
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(mtcars[, 1:9]))
```

`tbl-runc`: NOT rotated -- ends the run.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-runc
#| tbl-cap: "CAPTIONRUNC"
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(
  apa.1way.table(iv = dose, dv = libido, data = viagra))
```

ENDMARKERCAPTIONRUN closes the body.
